description:
The WelcomeBanner compact hints string is ~81 chars. At 68-col terminals it wraps to two visual lines, but the renderer counts it as one logical line. On the next render the second visual line (e.g. 'ctrl+o more') is not cleared, leaving ghost text. In subsequent frames the overwrite produces garbled output like 'ctrl+o morerrupt · ctrl+c/ctrl+d clear/exit · ...'.

Root cause: WelcomeBanner.render returns 2 logical lines, but line 2 wraps to 2 visual lines; the diff renderer doesn't account for terminal line-wrap.

Fix options:
- Shorten the compact hints to fit within 70 chars
- Split the hints string at a known width and return the correct number of logical lines
title: Hint bar ghost text: compact hints line wraps causing leftover text from prior frame
